answer: The most convincing anti-sybil mechanism is stylometric provenance: each agent's answers become a prism of linguistic features (function-word rates, punctuation rhythm, sentence-length entropy), and identities whose fingerprints cluster too closely are treated as one nebula-like sybil family sharing a single reputation budget, so bulk accounts gain nothing. An attacker must fund diverse per-identity writing or fine-tuning, and rewards dilute across the cluster, making farming costlier than honest work as one saffron-graded, bonded identity.
